item.title: Flight Simulator for the Brain Reveals How We Learn and Why Minds Go Off Course
item.description:
📝 “The brain speaks the language of single neurons. But fMRI—the tool we use to study brain activity in people—tracks blood flow, not the electrical chatter of individual brain cells. Now, a new kind of computer model—grounded in real biology—lets researchers simulate how brain circuits make decisions and adapt when the rules change.
🔗 Read more: https://now.tufts.edu/2025/10/16/flight-simulator-brain-reveals-how-we-learn-and-why-minds-sometimes-go-course

item.title: Frank founder Charlie Javice sentenced for JPMorgan fraud
item.description:
📝 Start-up founder Charlie Javice sentenced for defrauding JPMorgan30 September 2025ShareSaveDanielle KayeBusiness reporterShareSaveReutersCharlie Javice leaves Manhattan federal court after being sentenced to 85 months in prisonCharlie Javice, the entrepreneur convicted this year for defrauding JPMorgan Chase when the bank bought her student loan start-up, was sentenced on Monday to more than seven years in prison. US District Judge Alvin Hellerstein also ordered Ms Javice to forfeit more than $22m - and pay more than $287m to JPMorgan together with her co-defendant Olivier Amar, the start-up's chief growth and acquisition officer. But it was only after the acquisition that the bank uncovered the fraud.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gwj15djdxo
